intelligence.enrichment: Planets closer to the Sun generally receive more heat, but a thick atmosphere rich in carbon dioxide can trap heat strongly, so Venus is the hottest planet even though it is not closest to the Sun. distance from the Sun plus atmospheric heat trapping -> planet temperature The learner correctly uses the chapter relationship: Planets closer to the Sun generally receive more heat, but a thick atmosphere rich in carbon dioxide can trap heat strongly, so Venus is the hottest planet even though it is not closest to the Sun. The closest planet to the Sun must always be the hottest planet.
